storeInfo.name: Maithai Restaurant
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Thai Flavors in the Heart of Milford | Sabores Tailandeses Auténticos en el Corazón de Milford

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Crujientes rollitos rellenos de vegetales frescos y fideos de cristal, servidos con salsa agridulce.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy rolls filled with fresh vegetables and glass noodles, served with sweet and sour sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Brochetas de pollo marinadas en especias tailandesas, servidas con salsa de maní y ensalada de pepino.
products.descriptionEn: Grilled chicken skewers marinated in Thai spices, served with peanut sauce and cucumber salad.

products.descriptionEs: Fideos de arroz salteados con huevo, brotes de soja, maní y su elección de proteína.
products.descriptionEn: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, bean sprouts, peanuts, and your choice of protein.

products.descriptionEs: Curry aromático con leche de coco, albahaca tailandesa, bambú y pimientos picantes.
products.descriptionEn: Aromatic curry with coconut milk, Thai basil, bamboo shoots, and spicy peppers.

products.descriptionEs: Té tailandés dulce y cremoso servido con leche evaporada sobre hielo.
products.descriptionEn: Sweet and creamy Thai tea served with evaporated milk over ice.

products.descriptionEs: Empanadillas japonesas al vapor rellenas de cerdo tierno y verduras, servidas con salsa de soja y sésamo.
products.descriptionEn: Steamed Japanese dumplings filled with tender pork and vegetables, served with a savory soy-sesame dipping sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Camarones frescos rebozados en una ligera y crujiente pasta tempura, acompañados de salsa agridulce.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh shrimp coated in a light and crispy tempura batter, served with a tangy sweet and sour sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Panqueques asiáticos dorados y crujientes por fuera, suaves por dentro, con cebollino fresco y salsa jengibre.
products.descriptionEn: Golden brown Asian pancakes, crispy on the outside and chewy inside, infused with fresh scallions and ginger dip.

products.descriptionEs: Trozos de tofu dorado en brocheta con un glaseado de maní dulce y picante y cilantro fresco.
products.descriptionEn: Golden tofu chunks on skewers glazed with a sweet and spicy peanut sauce and topped with fresh cilantro.

products.nameEs: Alitas de Pollo con Salsa Tamarindo
products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo crujientes bañadas en una salsa de tamarindo agridulce con un toque de chile tailandés.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in a sticky sweet-and-sour tamarind glaze with a hint of Thai chili.

products.descriptionEs: Tortitas tradicionales de pescado sazonadas con pasta de curry rojo, hojas de lima kaffir y judías verdes.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional fish cakes spiced with red curry paste, kaffir lime leaves, and long beans, served with cucumber relish.

products.descriptionEs: Rollitos envueltos en papel de arroz con tofu, fideos de arroz, menta, albahaca y lechuga, con salsa de cacahuete.
products.descriptionEn: Rice paper rolls packed with tofu, rice noodles, mint, basil, and lettuce, served with house peanut sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Arroz salteado al wok con ajo, chile, cebolla, albahaca sagrada y su elección de proteína.
products.descriptionEn: Wok-fried rice tossed with garlic, fresh chili, onions, sacred holy basil, and your choice of protein.

products.descriptionEs: Fideos de arroz anchos salteados con vegetales mixtos, chile fresco, ajo y aromática albahaca tailandesa.
products.descriptionEn: Wide flat rice noodles stir-fried with mixed vegetables, fresh chili, garlic, and aromatic Thai basil leaves.

products.nameEs: Pollo al Anacardo (Gai Med Ma Muang)
products.descriptionEs: Trozos tiernos de pollo salteados con anacardos tostados, cebollas, pimientos y salsa de soja dulce.
products.descriptionEn: Tender chicken chunks stir-fried with roasted cashew nuts, onions, bell peppers, and a sweet chili soy sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Curry amarillo suave con leche de coco, patatas, zanahorias y cebolla tierna, acompañado de arroz jazmín.
products.descriptionEn: Mild yellow curry simmered in coconut milk with potatoes, carrots, and sweet onions, served with jasmine rice.

products.descriptionEs: Lomo de ternera tierno salteado en una robusta salsa de ajo y pimienta negra sobre una cama de lechuga.
products.descriptionEn: Tender beef slices stir-fried in a rich garlic and black pepper sauce, served over a bed of fresh lettuce.

products.descriptionEs: Fideos de arroz anchos salteados con brócoli chino, huevo y salsa de soja oscura caramelizada.
products.descriptionEn: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with Chinese broccoli, egg, and a sweet caramel dark soy sauce.
Slow-braised tender lamb shank in a rich Massaman curry sauce with potatoes, peanuts, and crispy shallots.

products.nameEs: Pato al Curry Rojo con Piña
products.descriptionEn: Crispy roasted duck in aromatic red curry with sweet pineapple chunks, cherry tomatoes, grapes, and Thai basil.

products.nameEs: Pescado Entero al Vapor con Lima y Chile
products.nameEn: Steamed Whole Fish with Lime & Chili
products.descriptionEn: Fresh whole fish steamed to perfection, topped with a zesty, spicy garlic, lime juice, and fresh chili broth.

products.nameEs: Mariscos al Wok en Salsa de Albahaca Crujiente
products.descriptionEn: Assorted shrimp, scallops, and squid stir-fried with vegetables and topped with crispy fried holy basil leaves.
Chef's curated platter featuring spring rolls, chicken satay, dumplings, and crispy shrimp tempura.

products.nameEs: Ternera con Salsa de Sésamo y Jengibre
products.descriptionEn: Sizzling beef tenderloin stir-fried with fresh julienned ginger, shiitake mushrooms, scallions, and toasted sesame.

products.nameEs: Curry Panaeng con Solomillo de Cerdo
products.descriptionEn: Thicker, richer Panaeng curry simmered with tender pork loin strips, fragrant kaffir lime leaves, and coconut milk.

products.nameEs: Fideos de Arroz con Pollo al Curry Verde Crujiente
products.descriptionEn: Crispy breaded chicken cutlet served over flat rice noodles drenched in our signature aromatic green curry sauce.
Refreshing homemade lemonade infused with fresh-pressed ginger juice and garden mint leaves.
Strongly brewed dark Thai roasted coffee poured over ice and topped with sweet condensed milk.
100% natural and pure young coconut water served chilled right out of the fresh coconut with tender pulp.
Delicate green tea infused with fragrant jasmine blossoms, lightly sweetened and served over ice.
Rich and creamy blended smoothie made with sweet ripe tropical mangoes and a touch of coconut milk.
Sparkling soda mixed with sweet lychee nectar and pieces of real exotic lychee fruit.

products.nameEs: Té de Hierba de Limón Caliente
products.descriptionEn: Soothing and aromatic infusion of Thai lemongrass and ginger roots with a touch of organic honey.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, pregunte a nuestro personal por las opciones marcadas en el menú.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please ask our staff for items marked on the menu.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and phone reservations.
